full_story_part2_c1_k1.canonical_text: At the river, he stopped. The bridge was gone. Rain had turned the water brown and violent. He stepped back, ran, and threw himself into the flood. The current pulled him under. He fought toward the light, caught a branch, and dragged himself onto the far bank. Farther along, three men blocked the road. A knife flashed. Melos struck the man holding it with his walking stick and ran uphill, their shouts following him.
